Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
 Office Notes,
Date reports,
 orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C-528 No.631 of 2024  Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. M.A. Khan, AGA for the State.

The challenge in this petition is made to the order dated 14.08.2023, passed in Misc. Case No.41 of 2018, by the court of First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, District Dehradun, by which, in Case Crime No.376 of 2017, under Sections 420, 406, 506 IPC, Police Station Patel Nagar, District Dehradun re-investigation has been has been ordered.

entities.text: First Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun, District Dehradun
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and perused the record.

The case is based on an FIR, lodged by the respondent no.3, according to which, there was an agreement between the respondent no.3 and the petitioner no.1, Rajesh Chopra with regard to Helicopter services.

After the use of Helicopter, according to the FIR, money was also given to the petitioner no.1 and, thereafter, in violation of the condition of the agreement petitioner no.1 provided his Helicopter services to the State of Uttarakhand and pressurized the informant to make more payment.
In this FIR, after investigation the Investigating Officer filed a Final Report stating that the dispute relates to an agreement and there is an arbitration clause.
It is basis of the case, in which informant was heard and, thereafter, impugned order has been passed.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that:-
(i) The court may not order re- investigation.

At the most, further investigation could have been ordered and;
(ii) The dispute is purely civil in nature covered by the arbitration clause.
C528/631/2024 on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40168749/
1
Having considered, this Court is of the view that this matter requires deliberation.
Admit.
Issue notice to the respondent no.3, returnable within six weeks.
Steps to be taken within a week.
Till the next date of listing, the effect and operation of the impugned order shall remain in abeyance.
Interim Relief Application (IA) No.1 of 2024, stands disposed of.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 07.10.2024 Sanjay C528/631/2024 on 7 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/40168749/
